observed_behavior: For specified legal commitments, financial transactions, user-controllable stored-data changes/deletions, or user test responses, at least one of reversible, checked-with-correction, or confirmed-with-review methods applies.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation Dec 12 2024; exact criterion level and exceptions
limitations: Scoped to listed consequential operations; it does not demand confirmation on every form submission.
